description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based frontend. It includes a custom hook to detect viewport size and conditionally renders either an overlay message for non-desktop viewports or the application's route component. It serves as the entry point for rendering the app UI and managing responsive behavior.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px). It listens to window resize events and updates its state reactively.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React functional component that renders an overlay message indicating the application requires a desktop environment. It is shown when the viewport is narrower than the breakpoint.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that uses the custom hook to determine viewport size and conditionally renders either the overlay or the application's route component.
